metaDescription: Persian vaccine schedule with core ages in weeks. Set reminders so Persian boosters are not missed.

bodySections.heading: Why timing matters for this schedule
paragraphs: Persian owners tracking 10-15 years lifespans still lose the mid-series booster more often than the first shot, and the unprotected gap after week 8 is where panleukopenia risk concentrates for this kitten.
Use the 4-row Persian schedule as your only planning spine: 8 weeks (FVRCP); 12 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (FVRCP booster); 16 weeks (Rabies).

Temperament note for Persian handling: Quiet lap cat; PKD screening conversations are breed-normal.. Schedule quieter appointment slots if that profile makes clinic visits harder, but do not skip the Persian dose.
Lifestyle add-ons stay off this Persian core list until your veterinarian maps exposure, so keep core dates sacred either way.

bodySections.heading: If a dose is missed or delayed
paragraphs: Owners postpone Persian shots when the kitten seems “a little off,” travel intervenes, or brachycephalic airway concerns worries dominate the week — ask the clinic whether a same-week Persian make-up is still appropriate instead of sliding to the annual exam.
Long gaps can leave Persian antibody levels uncertain, so expect either an added booster or a titer conversation rather than a shrug.
Do not trade the missed Persian dose for extra socialization; finish immunity first for this medium cat.
Reset the Persian reminder stack the evening of the make-up appointment — including the eventual adult booster after the 16-week finish.

faqs.question: When does the Persian core vaccine series usually finish?
faqs.answer: This breed record completes core vaccines around 16 weeks of age, with rabies timed per local law. Your clinic may adjust intervals for the individual kitten.

faqs.question: What should I do if my Persian misses a booster?
faqs.answer: Contact your veterinarian for a catch-up plan instead of restarting or skipping ahead. Keep prior dates handy and limit high-risk exposure until the series is current again.

faqs.question: Where can I read Persian health context beyond vaccines?
faqs.answer: See the Persian adult health guide for breed predispositions such as brachycephalic airway concerns, then bring those notes to wellness and vaccine visits.
